early_in_person.hours_note: Escambia County: Monday, October 19 through Saturday, October 31 (no Sunday, November 1), 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time, at 10 sites.

situations.short: Call the Escambia vote-by-mail office at (850) 595-3900, or vote in person instead.
situations.answer: The deadline to have a ballot mailed was October 22. Call the Escambia vote-by-mail office at (850) 595-3900 (toll free 1-877-595-8683), Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and ask what they can do. Or vote in person: early voting runs through Saturday, October 31, 8 AM to 6 PM, at any of 10 sites, then Election Day at your precinct, 7 AM to 7 PM. Still have the mail ballot? Bring it so they can cancel it.

notes: Drop boxes (secure ballot intake stations) are at all 10 early voting sites through Saturday, October 31, 8 AM to 6 PM. After that, hand your mail ballot in at the elections office, 213 Palafox Place, 2nd floor (weekdays 8 AM to 5 PM). It must arrive by 7 PM on November 3; call (850) 595-3900 to check the office's hours that day.

sources.name: Escambia SOE: early voting locations and drop boxes

dated.text: Early voting and its drop boxes closed Saturday, October 31. Hand your mail ballot in at the elections office, 213 Palafox Place, 2nd floor (weekdays 8 AM to 5 PM). It must arrive by 7 PM on November 3; call (850) 595-3900 to check the office's hours that day.

The deadline to have a ballot mailed was October 22. Call the Escambia vote-by-mail office at (850) 595-3900 (toll free 1-877-595-8683), Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and ask what they can do. Or vote in person: early voting ended Saturday, October 31, so vote at your precinct on Election Day, 7 AM to 7 PM. Still have the mail ballot? Bring it so they can cancel it.
